statements.chinese: 好吧。好吧。好吧。Joey，我有件事必须告诉你！

statements.english: What-what is it , what is it ?
statements.chinese: 什么—这是什么，这是什么？

statements.english: Oh my God , it's so huge
statements.chinese: 天啊，这也太大了，

statements.english: but you just have to promise me that you cannot tell anyone
statements.chinese: 但你得向我保证不能告诉任何人。

statements.english: Oh no , no-no-no-no ! I don't want to know !
statements.chinese: 噢不，不不不不！我一点都不想知道！

statements.english: Yes ! Yes ! Yes , you do want to know ! This is unbelievable !
statements.chinese: 没错！没错！你确实想知道！这简直难以置信！

statements.english: I don't care , Rach ! Look , I am tired of being the guy
statements.chinese: 我不在乎，Rach！听着，我受够了当那个

statements.english: who knows all the secrets but can't tell anyone !
statements.chinese: 知晓所有秘密却无法向任何人倾诉！

statements.english: What ? What secrets ? You know secrets ? What are they ?
statements.chinese: 什么？什么秘密？你知道秘密？都是些什么？

statements.english: And you're not supposed to be gossiping !!
statements.chinese: 而且你不该在这里说闲话！！

statements.english: I know , I know ! I just can't keep this one in
statements.chinese: 我知道，我知道！我就是憋不住这个秘密了，

statements.english: so I pick up the phone ..
statements.chinese: 于是我拿起电话...

statements.english: I'm not listening to you !
statements.chinese: 我才不听你的！

statements.english: Ross , umm , you've been in there for a long time
statements.chinese: Ross，嗯，你在里面待了很久了。

been.definition: be（过去分词）: 构成现在完成时

statements.english: I'm starting to get kinda freaked out
statements.chinese: 我开始有点慌了。

statements.english: All right , I'm coming out
statements.chinese: 好的，我这就出来。

statements.english: Hey , can you turn the lights off
statements.chinese: 嘿，你能把灯关掉吗？

statements.english: No , let's just leave the lights on
statements.chinese: 不，我们就让灯开着吧。

statements.english: Oh my God !
statements.chinese: 天啊！

statements.english: I had a problem
statements.chinese: 我遇到了一个问题。

statements.english: Hey , Pheebs ?
statements.chinese: 嘿，Pheebs？

statements.english: I can't talk to you !
statements.chinese: 我不能和你说话！

statements.english: I don't have a fancy ad in the Yellow Pages !
statements.chinese: 我可没在黄页上登什么花哨的广告！

statements.english: Look , Pheebs , I just
statements.chinese: 听着，Pheebs，我只是，

statements.english: I wanna apologize for
statements.chinese: 我想为

statements.english: for saying that your method was stupid
statements.chinese: 说你的方法很愚蠢

statements.english: and-and maybe ask you to be my teacher again
statements.chinese: 然后——或许能再次请你当我的老师。

statements.english: And-and I promise
statements.chinese: 我-我保证，

statements.english: I won't touch a guitar until you say I'm ready
statements.chinese: 在你认可我准备好之前，我不会碰吉他。

statements.english: - You really think I'm ready ? - Uh-huh !
statements.chinese: - 你真觉得我准备好了吗？ - 嗯哼！

statements.english: Wow ! Cool !
statements.chinese: 哇！太酷了！

statements.english: - Was the chord at least right beofre ... - No !
statements.chinese: - 至少之前的和弦是对的吧... - 不！

statements.english: Oh my God !
statements.chinese: 天啊！

statements.english: We heard about your pants , I'm so sorry
statements.chinese: 听说你裤子的事，我深感遗憾。

statements.english: This year was supposed to be great !
statements.chinese: 今年本该是美好的一年！

was.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去时

statements.english: But , it's only the second day and I'm a loser
statements.chinese: 但是，这才第二天，我就已经是个失败者了

statements.english: with stupid leather pants that don't even fit !
statements.chinese: 还穿着不合身的蠢皮裤！

that.definition: 那个（关系代词，引导定语从句）

statements.english: No . No , you're not a loser
statements.chinese: 不，不，你不是个失败者。

statements.english: Look at me !
statements.chinese: 看着我！

statements.english: Hey , hey , look
statements.chinese: 嘿，嘿，快看。

statements.english: Look Ross , Ben drew a picture of you !
statements.chinese: Ross你看，Ben给你画了幅画像！

statements.english: Huh ? You're-you're a cowboy !
statements.chinese: 啊？你——你是个牛仔！

statements.english: Oh , be-because of the leather pants
statements.chinese: 哦，是—是因为那条皮裤。

statements.english: See ? Ben doesn't think you're a loser
statements.chinese: 看到了吗？Ben并不认为你是个失败者，

statements.english: he thinks you're a cowboy ! Now that's something
statements.chinese: 他觉得你是个牛仔！这可真有意思。

thinks.definition: think（第三人称单数）: 认为

statements.english: Yeah ! That really is something ; that's really cool
statements.chinese: 哇！这确实了不起；这真的太酷了。

statements.english: Howdy partner !
statements.chinese: 你好啊，伙计！

statements.english: Maybe I should get another pair !
statements.chinese: 也许我该再买一双！

statements.english: Ooh , y'know , they-they had some
statements.chinese: 哦，你知道的，他们——他们确实有一些

statements.english: with fringe all down the sides
statements.chinese: 两侧都饰有流苏。

statements.english: I'm gonna go kiss Ben goodnight
statements.chinese: 我要去给Ben一个晚安吻。

statements.english: I can't believe he thinks I'm a cowboy
statements.chinese: 真不敢相信他以为我是个牛仔。

thinks.definition: think（第三人称单数）: 认为

statements.english: I would make a good cowboy
statements.chinese: 我会是个好牛仔。

would.definition: will（过去式）: 表示意愿或假设
